advice.thin: Margem baixa — esta atividade apresenta risco
advice.breakEvenClose: O seu preço de equilíbrio está próximo do piso do mercado
advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) exceed your projected revenue ({revenue}). Before committing funds, review costs, yield and the market price.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% is low for agriculture. A drop in price or yield could remove your profit; reduce costs and secure better buyers.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% is a solid return if your inputs and selling price hold. Monitor seasonal prices and input-cost inflation.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% is excellent. Confirm the result at a manageable scale, secure buyers and keep detailed cost records.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price for {commodity} is around {low}. Reduce costs or target premium buyers if prices fall.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices are highly seasonal. Consider dry-season production and rapid transport or processing to reduce post-harvest losses.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Stake cucumbers to improve quality and reduce disease. Urban supermarkets, hotels and restaurants can pay a premium.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Value addition can improve cassava returns. Early weed management is essential for protecting yield.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Storage can improve maize returns after harvest. Use safe storage to sell when seasonal stocks are lower.
advice.tipRiceBody: Milling and quality grading can increase rice value. Plan drying and market access before harvest.
advice.tipHabaneroTitle: Dica para cultivo de pimenta habanero
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Harvest frequently and handle peppers carefully. Secure buyers before peak harvest to manage price swings.
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is the main cost. Buy reliable chicks, manage feed closely and plan sales before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerBody: Track feed conversion and egg production daily. Stable buyers and good flock health protect margins.
advice.tipFishBody: Control feed waste and water quality. Grade fish regularly and arrange buyers before harvest.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.
advice.tipCattleBody: Buy healthy animals and plan sales around strong demand periods. Feed efficiency drives the margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Time sales for high-demand periods and keep animals healthy. Mature goats can command premium prices.
advice.costControlBody: Analise primeiro os maiores custos. O investimento modelado é {cost}. Compare sementes, ração, fertilizantes, mão de obra, irrigação, transporte e perdas pós-colheita com os preços locais e reduza custos evitáveis sem comprometer a qualidade.
advice.marketTitle: Planeie o mercado antes de produzir
advice.marketBody: Não espere pela colheita para procurar compradores. Verifique os preços atuais, identifique pelo menos dois canais de venda, confirme os requisitos de qualidade e estime transporte e embalagem antes de investir.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: Use o ponto de equilíbrio como referência
advice.breakEvenActionBody: O seu preço de equilíbrio calculado é {price}. Compare-o com preços locais realistas e teste um cenário com menor preço ou rendimento antes de plantar.
advice.recordsTitle: Registe dados para o próximo ciclo
advice.recordsBody: Registe quantidades de insumos, mão de obra, datas, rendimento, preço de venda, perdas e recebimentos. Compare os resultados reais com o relatório para melhorar o próximo orçamento.
advice.returnVisitTitle: Volte após o ciclo de produção
advice.returnVisitBody: Guarde este relatório e volte após a colheita para comparar custos, rendimento, preço e lucro reais com as estimativas. Essa comparação melhora os próximos planos.
